title: Beautiful Classic Flatware
text: Beautiful Classic Flatware. We purchased this set after looking quite a bit.  It was an excellent purchase.  Our set is a 101 piece set that we purchased 2-3 years ago.  One of my best purchases.  Nice and sturdy and feels good in your hand.  Goes well with I would think most dinnerware.  Would absolutely recommend this set.  People have commented on it at Thanksgiving and Christmas dinners.  I believe this set will last for many years.  I also have the 4 piece hostess set with the cake kinfe, cake server, large round spoon, and the gravy ladle.  Excellent quality and I am particular.  I just might store our everyday flatware and use this all the time since their are so many pieces.
